fluff.overview: New technology and creative tactical thinking have long featured in FWLM infantry deployment, with varied unit types and specialized formations treated as the norm rather than the exception. Jump infantry in League service exploit vertical mobility to compensate for the FWLM's sometimes fragmented command structure, seizing terrain that wheeled or tracked forces cannot reach. Their ability to operate across broken ground and urban environments makes them valuable in the border provinces where coalition territory changes hands frequently. Armed with standard ballistic assault rifles, the most common and affordable infantry weapon in the Inner Sphere, these platoons deliver reliable short-range firepower and can be equipped and resupplied from almost any garrison stockpile.
